description: An electrolytic capacitor: stores a little charge. From the Arduino's RESET pin to GND it stops the board resetting itself when the computer opens the port — needed when the Arduino acts as a programmer.
how_to_use: Polarized: the − leg (short, by the pale stripe) to GND, the + leg to the other side. Backwards it can fail.

plain.what: A small can that stores a little electricity for a moment — like a tiny rechargeable battery.
plain.how: It only goes one way: the leg by the pale stripe is −, and goes to GND.

pins.NEG: the short leg (−), by the stripe
